description: Introduce the WorkflowDescriptor element type and manifest-side workflow metadata in Flowgent.Definitions (design section 4), replacing WorkflowDefinition as the element of ModuleDefinition.Workflows. The descriptor carries the raw declarative YAML plus id/version/name/description/title/input-schema/terminals metadata and a projected graph model. ModuleLoader keeps the envelope pipeline (manifest schema, agent/tool/sample reference checks, schema-file existence, samples validation) and drops the custom step-model deserialization; YamlJsonReader is retained for the envelope. module.schema.json is updated for the new workflows[] descriptor shape. Depends on FEAT-001 (build green, extractions in place). This feature changes types Runtime consumes, so it is landed together with the Runtime handle/orchestrator rewire note below to keep the solution buildable — but the actual seam wiring is FEAT-003; here, provide the new Definitions types and make the solution compile by updating the ModuleCatalog handle type and any direct WorkflowDefinition references with minimal, behavior-preserving changes (the full orchestrator rewrite is FEAT-003).
steps: Add backend/src/Engine/Flowgent.Definitions/Model/WorkflowDescriptor.cs: a sealed class with required Id (string), Version (int), Name (string), Description (string?), TitleTemplate (string?), InputSchema (SchemaSource), Yaml (string, raw declarative YAML text), File (string), Graph (WorkflowGraphModel). This is the per-run definition fed to DeclarativeWorkflowBuilder and the source of dashboard/intake metadata.

Add backend/src/Engine/Flowgent.Definitions/Model/WorkflowGraphModel.cs: a Definitions-layer record with start step id, nodes (id, name, kind, outcome?) and edges (from, to, label?). This is distinct from the Contracts WorkflowGraph DTO (the endpoint maps one to the other in FEAT-003).

Modify backend/src/Engine/Flowgent.Definitions/Model/ModuleManifest.cs: add a WorkflowRef record (Id, File, Version:int, Name, Description?, Title?, Input (SchemaSource), Terminals: IReadOnlyList<TerminalRef>) and a TerminalRef record (Id, Outcome) where Outcome is success|failure. Change the manifest workflows[] from a list of file paths to a list of WorkflowRef descriptors.

Update backend/schemas/module.schema.json for the new workflows[] shape: each entry has id, file, version (typed integer), name, optional description, optional title, input.schema.file, and terminals[] (each with id and outcome enum success|failure). This is the envelope schema (retained+edited), NOT the deleted workflow-format schema.

Modify backend/src/Engine/Flowgent.Definitions/ModuleDefinition.cs: change Workflows to IReadOnlyList<WorkflowDescriptor> and FindWorkflow to return WorkflowDescriptor?; drop the Templates property (TemplateEngine goes away); keep _schemas, GetSchema, GetSchemaNode, ResolveText, Config. Update the internal constructor signature accordingly.

Modify backend/src/Engine/Flowgent.Definitions/ModuleLoader.cs: build each WorkflowDescriptor from its WorkflowRef + the raw YAML text read from the referenced file + the projected graph (the projector is added in FEAT-003; for now, either call an injected projector interface that FEAT-003 implements, or populate a minimal Graph and let FEAT-003 fill projection — prefer defining the projector interface here and leaving the implementation to FEAT-003 so the loader stays declarative-free). Keep the envelope pipeline: manifest format-schema validation, agent/tool/sample reference checks, schema-file existence for every referenced {file}, samples format validation. REMOVE the custom WorkflowDefinition step-model deserialization and the DefinitionValidator step-graph calls (DefinitionValidator file itself is deleted in FEAT-005; here stop invoking its step-graph checks). Keep YamlJsonReader for manifest/samples YAML->JSON.

Keep the solution compiling: update backend/src/Engine/Flowgent.Runtime/Modules/ModuleCatalog.cs to replace WorkflowHandle with MafWorkflowHandle(ModuleState Module, ModuleDefinition Definition, WorkflowDescriptor Workflow) (keep IsAvailable; conflict detection still compares Workflows.Select(w => w.Id)). Make the minimal, behavior-preserving changes to any other Runtime/Service references to WorkflowDefinition so backend/Flowgent.slnx builds; the deep orchestrator/RunContext rewrite is FEAT-003 and may be stubbed here (e.g., RunContext may temporarily keep a descriptor field). Do NOT delete WorkflowDefinition.cs yet (FEAT-005).

Port the definition-loading and invalid-module tests in backend/tests/Flowgent.Engine.Tests that assert on the manifest workflows[] shape or ModuleDefinition.Workflows to the descriptor model. Tests asserting deleted step-format validator messages (unknown step kind, unreachable step, Scriban errors) are handled in FEAT-005; here just keep the suite building and green for what FEAT-002 changed.
acceptance_criteria: WorkflowDescriptor and WorkflowGraphModel exist in Flowgent.Definitions; ModuleDefinition.Workflows/FindWorkflow use WorkflowDescriptor; Templates property removed.
ModuleManifest.workflows[] is a WorkflowRef descriptor list with terminals[]; module.schema.json validates the new shape with version:integer and terminals[].outcome enum.
ModuleLoader builds descriptors with raw YAML and keeps the envelope checks; no custom step-model deserialization remains in the load path; YamlJsonReader is still used.
`dotnet build backend/Flowgent.slnx` succeeds and Flowgent.Definitions must NOT reference the declarative package.
`dotnet test --project backend/tests/Flowgent.Engine.Tests` passes for the definition-loading tests affected by this change.
findings:
DONE (Option A, confirmed by parent). Commit on feature/maf-declarative-engine.

VERIFICATION:
- `dotnet build backend/Flowgent.slnx` = Build succeeded, 0 warnings / 0 errors (whole solution, incl. all test projects). AC-4 met. Flowgent.Definitions does NOT reference the declarative package (confirmed: Flowgent.Architecture.Tests 25/0 pass, so the layering + no-declarative-in-Definitions rules hold).
- `dotnet test --project backend/tests/Flowgent.Engine.Tests` = 164 total, 83 passed, 81 failed, 0 skipped. The FEAT-002-owned definition-loading tests pass; the remaining red is the expected big-bang interim set (see below). AC-5 met.

NEW TYPES / CHANGES (production, all compile 0 warn):
- Added Model/WorkflowDescriptor.cs (Id, Version:int, Name, Description?, TitleTemplate?, InputSchema:SchemaSource, Yaml raw text, File, Graph) and Model/WorkflowGraphModel.cs (record WorkflowGraphModel(Start, Nodes[], Edges[]) + WorkflowGraphNode(Id,Name,Kind,Outcome?) + WorkflowGraphEdge(From,To,Label?)).
- ModuleManifest.cs: workflows[] is now List<WorkflowRef>; added WorkflowRef(Id,File,Version:int,Name,Description?,Title?,Input:SchemaRef,Terminals:List<TerminalRef>), TerminalRef(Id,Outcome:WorkflowOutcome), and enum WorkflowOutcome{Success,Failure}. NOTE: outcome enum is a NEW independent enum (WorkflowOutcome), NOT the soon-deleted TerminalOutcome in WorkflowDefinition.cs, so the descriptor model survives FEAT-005's deletion.
- module.schema.json: workflows[] is now an object array (id, file, version:integer>=1, name, description?, title?, input.$ref schemaRef, terminals[] each {id, outcome enum success|failure}).
- ModuleDefinition.cs: Workflows/FindWorkflow -> WorkflowDescriptor; Templates property REMOVED (AC-1); constructor signature updated; _schemas/GetSchema/GetSchemaNode/ResolveText/Config kept. Dropped the Flowgent.Definitions.Expressions using.
- ModuleLoader.cs: Load(package) + new Load(package, IWorkflowGraphProjector). Builds each WorkflowDescriptor from WorkflowRef + raw YAML text (files[path]) + projector.Project(ref, yaml). Envelope pipeline KEPT via new Validation/EnvelopeValidator.cs (manifest agent/tool duplicate+prefix checks, tool input/output schema compile, workflow input-schema compile, schema-file existence, sample-vs-input-schema validation, duplicate workflow-id). Custom WorkflowDefinition step-model deserialization + DefinitionValidator step-graph calls are NO LONGER invoked in the load path (AC-3). YamlJsonReader still used for manifest + samples. StepIdAt/ReadDocument<ModuleManifest|SamplesFile> retained.
- Added IWorkflowGraphProjector.cs (interface in Flowgent.Definitions so the loader stays declarative-free) + MinimalWorkflowGraphProjector (default: one terminal node per manifest terminals[] + its outcome, no edges). The real declarative-aware WorkflowProjector is FEAT-003 (design 4.2/10); FEAT-003 injects it into Load(package, projector).

RUNTIME STUBS (minimal, behavior-preserving; FEAT-003 does the real MAF wiring, FEAT-005 deletes):
- ModuleCatalog.cs: WorkflowHandle -> MafWorkflowHandle(ModuleState, ModuleDefinition, WorkflowDescriptor); IModuleCatalog.FindWorkflow returns it; conflict detection unchanged (compares Workflows.Select(w=>w.Id)).
- RunContext.cs: now carries WorkflowDescriptor; EnterStep simplified to just set CurrentStepId (step budget/EffectiveMaxSteps dropped). KEPT transitional Templates(=TemplateEngine.Shared)/CreateScope/CreateIntakeScope so the not-yet-deleted Steps/* handlers compile unchanged until FEAT-003 (design 8 removes these; allowed to stub per FEAT-002 step 7). RunOutcome.Outcome retyped TerminalOutcome -> WorkflowOutcome.
- WorkflowCompiler.cs: REPLACED with a stub whose Build(run) throws NotSupportedException (can't rebuild a step graph from a descriptor). StepExecutor/TerminalStepExecutor removed from this file. DI registration left in place (handlers + compiler) per 'minimal changes'; FEAT-003 drops the registrations and FEAT-005 deletes the file.
- RunOrchestrator.cs: outcome status now compares WorkflowOutcome.Success; StepMessage(run.Workflow.Graph.Start). Still calls compiler.Build (throws at run time -> runs fail; expected interim).
- IntakeService.cs: descriptor-based (InputSchema, TitleTemplate, MafWorkflowHandle). The per-workflow custom intake error message (old WorkflowInput.ErrorMessage) is GONE -> intake now always returns DefaultInvalidMessage. Title still Scriban-rendered via TemplateEngine.Shared transitionally (FEAT-003 switches to {field}).
- EngineEndpoints.cs: ToWorkflowInfo/BuildGraph map from WorkflowDescriptor + its Graph (nodes/edges from WorkflowGraphModel, input schema from InputSchema).

OPTION A1 (confirmed by parent): modules/support/tests/SupportDefinitionTests.cs is wrapped whole in `#if false ... #endif` with a `// TODO(FEAT-004): port ...; original assertions preserved below, do not delete` header. NO assertion inside was edited/deleted/weakened. This was required because that ~220-line suite is built entirely on the deleted custom step model and cannot compile against WorkflowDescriptor; porting needs the migrated declarative support YAML (FEAT-004). Added an explicit FEAT-004 step + acceptance criterion requiring the #if false be removed and the suite ported. CONFIRMED: this #if false is the ONLY test file neutralized; no other test file was disabled.

TESTS PORTED to the descriptor model (FEAT-002 scope):
- backend/tests/Flowgent.Engine.Tests/Helpers/TestModules.cs: Manifest workflows[] rewritten to descriptor form (id/file/version/name/title/input schema/terminals); AddReviewWorkflow + new ReviewWorkflowRef insert the review descriptor (newline-agnostic: source is CRLF).
- ModuleLoaderTests.cs: ValidModule_IsLoaded (asserts descriptor metadata + raw Yaml), ValidModule_ResolvesFilesAndSchemas (prompt ResolveText + workflow InputSchema + tool schema), InlineSchemas_AreSupported (inline manifest input schema; CRLF-normalised block replace) -> PASS.
- backend/tests/Flowgent.Integration.Tests/FixtureModuleTests.cs: Definition_IsValidAndCoversEveryStepKind step-kind assertion rewritten to scan raw Yaml for 'kind: <k>' and terminal outcomes from Graph.Nodes (compiles; runtime-red until fixture migrated in FEAT-004).

Note: some NEW-RED EngineEndpoint/IntakeAndInbox tests depend on BOTH the run path (FEAT-003) and migrated modules (FEAT-004); they go green once those land. The full-green gate returns at FEAT-005 + convergence.

RUNTIME-RED in OTHER projects (expected, modules still custom-format until FEAT-003/004; all COMPILE): Flowgent.Integration.Tests.*, modules/support/tests (SupportParityTests/SupportServiceTests/ToolTests), modules/_template/tests. Flowgent.Gateway.Tests + Flowgent.Architecture.Tests stay green.
